description: This file provides utility functions for analyzing and checking the content of ModelResponseStream objects, including determining if a stream is empty and inspecting nested choice and delta objects for meaningful content.

classes.name: Delta
classes.description: A data structure representing a delta in the response, potentially containing dynamic or additional fields.

classes.name: ModelResponseBase
classes.description: A base model defining common fields for model responses.

classes.name: ModelResponseStream
classes.description: A class representing a stream of model responses, with fields such as choices, usage, and provider-specific data.

methods.name: bool is_model_response_stream_empty(model_response: ModelResponseStream)
methods.description: Checks whether a given ModelResponseStream object contains meaningful content or is effectively empty.

methods.name: bool _has_meaningful_content(value: Any)
methods.description: Determines if a value contains any meaningful content (non-empty, non-null, etc.).

methods.name: bool _is_choice_non_empty(choice: Any)
methods.description: Deeply inspects a choice object to see if it has any meaningful data, including nested fields like delta, logprobs, or enhancements.

methods.name: bool _is_delta_non_empty(delta: Delta)
methods.description: Checks if a delta object contains any meaningful content by examining its attributes and extra fields.
